rules.statement: Each of the seven `base_drivers` has `values` of exactly three strings, one per forecast period listed in `base.forecast_periods` of the module context. `revenue_growth` values are decimals from -1 to 1; `ebitda_margin`, `capex_pct_revenue`, `tax_wc_pct_revenue` and `interest_rate` are decimals from 0 to 1; each has at most four decimal places. `dividends` and `debt_repayment` are non-negative amounts of at most six integer digits and four decimals. `minimum_liquidity.amount` is such an amount or `not assessed`, and `downside.scenario` has the form `s` and two digits.

Submit every field of the schema (`limitation` is null when there is none) and no other, valid JSON; each `break_metrics` `metric` is total_leverage, net_leverage or interest_coverage and `assessment.confidence` is one of the four listed values.
The running total of the three `debt_repayment` values never exceeds the opening total debt in the base operands of the module context.
`downside.scenario` is the `row` of one of the CP-2A `scenarios` in the module context.

`break_metrics` has exactly one entry for each CP-2A break that is not a definition break, its `break_id` that break's `row`, each once. A definition break has a fixed metric and is not named. The `metric` you give for a break must reproduce the required decline of that break in the CP-2A `breaks` of the module context, among those in `break_metrics_offered`.

Every `rationale`, `limitation` and gap field is nonblank prose with no bare figure (digits only inside a period or filing label); a figure appears only as `{ref|unit}` with a `ref` and `unit` listed in `cp1_facts` or `cp1d_facts`, closed and non-empty, and you state no peer ranking, instrument recommendation, recovery conclusion or probability weighting (phrases such as `versus peers`, `recommend`, `will recover` or `probability-weighted` are refused).
`assessment.confidence` is never High, because the driver values are uncited analyst assumptions.

When the run context's fiscal year does not run 1 January to 31 December, its reporting currency is not the single currency the CP-1 period register reports, its current period is blank and its currency is not USD, that register is unusable, or the context file itself is refused, the submission is refused alone, before the rest of it is read; a different submission does not cure it, only a corrected context or pack.
